err_csrf_error: The page's security token expired. Try again.
err_internal_error: Something went wrong on the server (reference {ref}).
err_invalid_ip_entries: These entries are not IP addresses or networks: {entries}
err_invalid_new_password: The new password must be {min}–{max} characters and match the confirmation.
err_method_not_allowed: This action is not allowed here.

err_pce_not_configured: The PCE connection has not been set up yet.

err_renew_self_signed_only: Only a self-signed certificate can be renewed here.
err_retention_order: Keep flows at least as long as connections are remembered, and daily summaries at least as long as flows.
err_stale_revision: Someone else saved these settings first. Reload to see their changes.
err_tls_file_missing: The file does not exist on this server (use an absolute path).
err_tls_pair_invalid: The certificate and key cannot be used together.

home_pce_stale: Out of date: the last check was {time}.
migrate_5x_effective_value: set to the value 5.x actually used
migrate_always_on: the PCE health check is always on in v6
migrate_cache_off_events_only: 5.x kept no traffic locally, so v6 collects events only; switch to full or alerts on the data collection page
migrate_cache_on_full: 5.x kept traffic locally, so v6 collects everything (full mode)
migrate_empty_is_unset: empty in 5.x, now recorded as not set
migrate_fixed_event_cap: v6 always splits event queries at the PCE's 10,000-event limit
migrate_fixed_path: v6 keeps this in a fixed place under data/
migrate_invalid_in_5x: the 5.x file has values 5.x itself rejects; fix them in 5.x first
migrate_no_profiles: v6 connects to one PCE and has no profiles
migrate_no_sampling: v6 does not filter or sample traffic: it would hide lateral movement from detection
migrate_normalized: carried over after the clean-up 5.x applied (spaces trimmed, text turned into true/false, trailing slash removed)
migrate_org_id_not_numeric: not a numeric organization ID; fix it in 5.x first
migrate_password_default: no password was set, so the 5.x default applies
migrate_password_hashed: the stored plain-text password was hashed
migrate_raised_for_archive: raised so archive files outlive the flows and events they hold
migrate_raised_to_baseline: raised so flows are kept longer than the 30-day baseline that new-connection detection compares against
migrate_secret_key_new: a new session signing key was created; everyone signs in again
migrate_section_rewritten: Carried over in a new form ({n})
migrate_tls_source: the self-signed flag became the certificate source setting
migrate_unknown_key: not a key this migration knows; check it by hand
migrate_v6_default_interval: 5.x's hourly default became v6's 10 minutes, so lateral movement is seen in time
mode_alert: Alerts: events, workloads and a few days of traffic
mode_alert_hint: Lighter: alerts on events and traffic, including new connections and lateral movement. Traffic is kept a few days and past traffic is not read back; the workbench and traffic reports only see those days.
mode_events_only_hint: Lightest: alerts on audit and system events, firewall tampering and ransomware protection. No traffic is collected, so traffic alerts, lateral-movement detection, the workbench and traffic reports are not available.
mode_full_hint: Everything: lateral-movement detection, the workbench and traffic reports. Traffic is kept 35 days by default and the last 30 days are read back when a PCE is connected.
pce_ca_path: CA bundle path on this server
pce_console_url_hint_on_prem: Used for links that open the PCE console. Leave empty to use the PCE URL.
pce_console_url_hint_saas: Used for links that open Illumio Console. Leave empty for https://console.illum.io; enter your own *.illumio.ai address if you have one.
pce_key_role_hint: Use a service account with the read-only (Global Viewer) role; it covers everything except Rule Hit Count.
pce_reset_archive_moved: Archive files of the previous PCE were moved to data/archive/{folder}.
pce_reset_notice: Data collected from the previous PCE was cleared; collection and a first backfill now start for this PCE.
pce_secret_hint: Leave unchanged to keep the saved value (re-enter it if you change the address or TLS check).
pce_url_hint_on_prem: The PCE's own address with its port, usually 8443.
pce_url_hint_saas: The regional API host Illumio gave you (an illum.io address, port 443), not the console address.
probe_auth_failed: Authentication failed (HTTP 401): check the API key and secret.
probe_health_bad: The PCE reports its status as {status}.
probe_health_unknown: The PCE health status could not be read.
probe_server_error: The PCE returned a server error.
probe_transport_ca_bundle: Cannot connect: the CA bundle file cannot be read on this server.
probe_transport_dns: Cannot connect: the PCE host name does not resolve.
probe_transport_tls: Cannot connect: TLS certificate verification failed.
pw_change_intro: You must change the password before continuing.
reason_another_pce: the flow database belongs to another PCE
reason_auth: the PCE rejected the API key
reason_rate_limit: the PCE request budget ran out
reason_timeout: the PCE did not answer in time
security_allowed_intro: Only these addresses can open the web UI; anything else gets no answer at all. Leave empty to allow every address.
security_allowed_label: Addresses or networks, one per line
security_password_changed: Password changed. Everyone else who was signed in has been signed out.
tls_auto_renew_days: Renew when this many days remain
tls_ca_intro: Generate a certificate request, have your CA sign it, then paste the signed certificate below.
tls_ca_title: Use a certificate signed by your CA
tls_csr_result: Certificate request (send this to your CA)
tls_disabled_note: HTTPS is off: the web UI is served over plain HTTP.
tls_enabled: Serve the web UI over HTTPS
tls_no_cert: No certificate yet. One is created when the service starts.
tls_restart_hint: Changes apply after the service restarts.
tls_restart_required: The certificate or its settings changed. Restart the service to use them.
verify_bundle: Verify with a CA bundle file
verify_system: Verify with the system's trusted CAs
visibility_blocked_only: Hosts that record only blocked traffic: {n}. Allowed lateral movement from them is not visible.
visibility_explain: Visibility is set per host in the PCE (VEN visibility level). Hosts that do not record allowed traffic cannot be checked for lateral movement; raise their level in the PCE to include them.
visibility_sees_allowed: Hosts that record allowed and blocked traffic: {n}
visibility_unknown: Hosts that have not reported a visibility level: {n}
tamper_cmd_nft_ruleset: List the firewall rules without counters (nftables)
tamper_cmd_nft_writer: See which process adds rules (nftables, needs bpftrace)
tamper_cmd_ven_evidence: The rules the VEN last found tampered (it keeps only the latest)
tamper_cmd_audit_rule: Record which process replaces the rules (iptables-legacy, auditd)
tamper_cmd_win_platform_log: Find the VEN's platform.log under its data directory (Windows)

focus_title_pivot_chain: {host} reached {target} through {via}; the two connections connect in time
focus_title_blocked_surge: {host} was blocked from {targets} hosts within {minutes} minutes

focus_title_account_fanout: Account {account} reached {targets} hosts on management ports
focus_title_peer_deviation: {host} started connecting to {target} on port {port}; no other host in its group of {group_size} ever has

focus_title_collection_gap: {count} collection gaps in the last 7 days
focus_title_pce_probe: The PCE health check is failing
focus_title_stale_selector: A label in {setting} no longer exists: {key}={value}
focus_title_events_only: Lateral-movement analysis needs full or alert collection
focus_why_detection: Lateral movement starts with exactly this kind of reach.
focus_why_exposure_asset: Each of these hosts is a way to the asset if it is compromised.
focus_why_pivot: Controlling this host cuts the paths that go through it.
focus_why_cross_env: Management ports across environments let an attacker step from a weaker environment into a stronger one.
focus_why_tamper_cycle: A regular cycle is usually another firewall program fighting the VEN over its table.
focus_why_tamper: Someone or something changes the host's firewall outside the PCE.
focus_why_ransomware: Ransomware spreads through such services; this one is in use, so plan its rule first.
focus_why_contradiction: Do not rank by these scores until the contradiction is explained.
focus_why_mode_switch: These connections need rules before the hosts are enforced.
focus_why_coverage: Analyses by process or user only see this share of the traffic.
focus_why_visibility: Allowed lateral movement on these hosts is invisible.
focus_why_gap: Nothing can be detected in a window that was not collected.
focus_why_health: Data stops arriving while it fails.
focus_why_setup: Findings about critical assets and the admin-group detector stay off until then.
focus_why_stale: The setting matches no host now.
focus_why_events_only: Traffic is not collected in events-only mode.
lateral_needs_traffic: Lateral-movement analysis needs full or alert collection mode.
lateral_baseline_backfilling: The initial backfill is still running; new management connections are reported once it finishes.
lateral_detect_never: The detectors have not run yet
lateral_exposure_never: The exposure graph has not been built yet
lateral_stale_selector: {setting}: the label {key}={value} is on no workload now

detector_collection_off: This collection mode does not read traffic.
detector_admin_groups_unset: Set the admin groups below to turn it on.

detector_no_admin_ports: No management ports are set: add some below to turn it on.
detector_no_env_labels: No workload carries the label key {label_key}.
detector_no_user_data: None of the {total} connections carries a user ({covered} do).
detector_no_process_data: {not_evaluable} connections on the listed ports carry no process.
detector_partial_users_none_from: {covered} of {total} connections carry a user; none from {kinds} hosts.
detector_partial_process: {not_evaluable} of {total} connections on the listed ports carry no process.

detector_activity_accumulating: Hourly activity has accumulated {days} of {required} days.
detector_live_only: Only live collection is evaluated; what the daily re-read adds is not counted.
detector_no_process_field: None of {total} connections carries an initiating process.
detector_partial_processes: {covered} of {total} connections carry an initiating process.
detector_partial_processes_none_from: {covered} of {total} connections carry an initiating process; none from {kinds} hosts do.

lateral_include_pce: Include the PCE's high-risk services of category admin
lateral_critical_hint: Hosts with any of these labels count as critical assets.
lateral_admin_hint: Hosts with any of these labels may use management ports.
lateral_labels_truncated: Only the first {n} values are listed.
lateral_observation_capped: The graph uses {days} days: the baseline keeps no more.
det_chain_window: Pivot chain: second leg within minutes

alert_bandwidth: At least {mbps} Mbps on one connection (threshold {threshold} Mbps)

alert_system_data_loss: Data is missing for {source} ({kind}) from {start} to {end}
alert_system_job_failing: Background job {job} has failed {failures} times in a row: {error}
alert_system_disk_low: Disk space is low: {free} left, warning below {warn}
alert_test_message: This is a test from illumio-ops. If you can read it, this channel works.
err_not_a_flow_alert: Only an alert about traffic has a policy to explain.
err_channel_credentials_required: The mail server or account changed: type the password again.
alert_evidence_hint: The connections or events behind this alert, read again now from the collected data.
alert_grouped_known_cause: Grouped under a known cause of tampering: recorded, not sent.
alert_note_add_label: Note (who looked, what was found, what was done)
channel_secret_hint: Shown masked. Leave it as it is to keep the saved value.
channels_intro: Alerts go to every channel turned on below. Each channel can be tested before saving.
channel_smtp_hint: Your mail server. Recipients get one message per run listing the new alerts.
channel_line_hint: A LINE Messaging API channel access token and the user or group ID to push to.
channel_telegram_hint: A bot token from BotFather and the chat ID it posts to.
channel_teams_hint: A Teams workflow (Power Automate) webhook URL.
channel_webhook_hint: Any HTTPS endpoint that accepts a JSON POST.
cond_side_hint: Matches any of the labels (all label keys), addresses or networks; leave empty for any.
evidence_empty: Nothing matches now: the data may have aged out.
evidence_gaps: {n} collection gap(s) in this period: the list may be incomplete.
evidence_none: This alert has no traffic or event evidence (a system check).
explain_no_rule: No rule covers this connection in the active policy.
explain_partial: One end could not be placed ({ends}): rules listed hold for the other end.
explain_unplaced: Neither end could be placed in the PCE, so nothing was asked.
rules_held: {n} held back by cooldown or rate limit
rules_pack_hint: The built-in best-practice rules. Adding what is missing keeps your changes; resetting puts the built-in rules back to their defaults and keeps your own rules.
rules_pack_append_confirm: Add the built-in rules that are not in the list?
rules_pack_replace_confirm: Put every built-in rule back to its default? Your own rules stay.
rule_status_incomplete: Data incomplete in the last window
rule_status_collection_off: Needs traffic collection (full or alert mode)
rule_cooldown: Quiet time after an alert (minutes, 0: none)
rule_critical_only: Only when a critical asset is involved
rule_event_severity: Event severity (all, err, warning, info; a|b; !x)
rule_event_types_hint: Comma separated; each an exact type, a|b, or a regular expression.
rule_preview_na: A system check cannot be tried on past data.
rule_traffic_hint: Counts the connections that grew within the window; the PCE's own counts are daily totals.
rule_bytes_hint: Byte data exists only on part of the traffic (enhanced data collection); the rule says so when it has none.
preview_increments_kept: Traffic growth is kept 26 hours: older traffic is not in the preview.
rule_delete_confirm: Delete this rule? Its past alerts stay.
migrate_active_channels: the channels listed as active are turned on
migrate_alias_key: an older name of the same setting
migrate_channel_incomplete: on in 5.x but missing what it needs to send; carried off — fill it in on the notification channels page
migrate_channel_invalid: not an https:// URL, which v6 requires; left empty
migrate_new_default: a new built-in rule (5.x had no such rule)

migrate_recipients_filtered: entries that are not one email address were left out
migrate_rule_bad_label: not a key=value label; left out
migrate_rule_bad_value: a value 5.x could not use either; left out
migrate_rule_disabled: carried turned off because part of it could not be carried
migrate_rule_filter_unsupported: this filter is not in v6.0; the rule is carried off without it
migrate_rule_first_process_only: v6 matches one initiating process; only the first was kept
migrate_rule_invalid: not a valid pattern; the rule is carried off with a match-anything pattern to fix
migrate_rule_iplist_name: an IP list name, which v6.0 rules cannot use; left out
migrate_rule_not_read_by_5x: 5.x stored this for system rules but never used it
migrate_rule_process_initiator: matched against the initiating process (what 5.x saw on outbound flows)
migrate_rule_threshold_alias: the CLI's misspelt threshold key; read as the threshold
migrate_rule_throttle_capped: a rate limit period longer than 7 days was cut to 7 days
migrate_rule_type_unsupported: a rule type v6 does not have
migrate_rule_window_raised: raised to 10 minutes, the shortest traffic collection interval
migrate_rules_listed: the rules are listed one by one below
migrate_smtp_auth_by_user: v6 signs in when an account is set
migrate_smtp_env_password: if 5.x took the SMTP password from the ILLUMIO_SMTP_PASSWORD environment variable, type it on the notification channels page
migrate_smtp_tls: STARTTLS when 5.x had TLS on, otherwise none
alert_tamper_confirmed: Reading: the VEN reverted a change; these events carry no process information; pattern on this host: {pattern}.
tamper_pattern_regular_cycle: a regular cycle (often another firewall program rewriting the VEN's table)
tamper_pattern_burst: a burst (changes by hand or by a script)
cond_exclude_hint: Flows matching any of these are left out; leave empty to exclude nothing.
rule_match_fields_hint: path=pattern, e.g. created_by.user.username=admin@example.com; notification_type looks in every notification. Patterns work as for event types, ! negates.
